checked_classes: Spec violations — checked acceptance criteria 1-5 against the diff evidence, implementation changes, OpenSpec files, and receipt files; no concrete unmet criterion is provable from the packet.

Correctness — reviewed broker offset mapping, auto-commit disabling, retention-floor checks, first-delivery validation, publish confirmation scan, cancellation path, and restart test runner flow; no packet-provable logic defect found.
Regressions — checked public LogBroker signatures, proto immutability, adapter boundaries, and documented behavior changes; no removed dependency or signature regression is evident in the diff.

Security — checked for hardcoded secrets, auth bypass flags, sensitive logging, tenant credential exposure, and unsafe fixture credentials; no blocking secret or auth bypass is present in the touched files.
Constraint breaches — checked A1-A3, R1-R5 applicability from the diff, S1-S4, P1 OpenSpec structure, and file-size indicators; no concrete breach is provable from the packet.

Silent failure — checked ignored live tests are invoked by exact name with marker checks, receipt status propagation, cleanup status handling, and expired-cursor fail-closed behavior; no swallowed required failure is evident.
